# Walk In Tubs Houston

> WalkInTubsHouston.com helps homeowners, seniors and caregivers in Houston and across Texas choose and install walk-in tubs, wheelchair-accessible transfer tubs, roll-in showers and walk-in showers. Part of the Aging Safely Baths family. BBB Accredited with an A+ rating. Quotes by phone at 1-888-779-2284 (BATH) or through the online quote form. Prices are quoted per home and are not published on the site.

## Pages

- [Walk in tubs Houston](https://walkintubshouston.com/): Walk-in tub types, safety features, white-glove installation process, Houston home considerations (slab foundations, second floors, water heaters, electrical), funding options (Medicare, VA HISA, Texas Amy Young Barrier Removal Program, IRS Publication 502), local senior resources, service-area ZIP codes, roll-in shower overview with an interactive 3D model, and FAQ.
- [Walk-in tub buying guide](https://walkintubshouston.com/walk-in-tub-buying-guide/): In-depth guide to choosing a walk-in tub: fit for the bather, measuring, sizes and seat height, inward, outward and transfer doors, fill and drain time, hot water capacity, hydrotherapy, materials, scald protection and electrical, Houston home factors, installation, cost factors, warranty questions, daily use, a pre-purchase checklist and FAQ.
- [Contact and quote request](https://walkintubshouston.com/pages/contact/): Request an installation quote by form or phone, what happens after you reach out, and service area.
- [Privacy policy](https://walkintubshouston.com/policies/privacy-policy/): How quote form information is collected, used and protected.

## Key facts

- Phone: 1-888-779-2284 (BATH)
- Service area: Houston, Harris County and surrounding communities (Katy, Sugar Land, Missouri City, Pearland, Friendswood, Pasadena, Baytown, League City, Galveston, The Woodlands, Spring, Humble, Kingwood, Cypress, Tomball, Conroe), plus customers statewide across Texas.
- Services: full white-glove installation (consultation, measuring, demo and haul-away of the old tub or shower, installation, walkthrough); supply-only orders with tech support included.
- Handicap showers: 30-year warranty on the entire shower; 1-year labor warranty with white-glove installation; very low threshold for wheelchair roll-in; no mud setting needed on shower pans; walls reinforced with multi-ply plywood; round drain (left, right or center) or trench drain at the entry; padded fold-up seat, grab bars, handheld shower; fully customizable.
- Related sites: Aging Safely Baths (https://www.agingsafelybaths.com/), Showers4Less (https://showers4less.com/), Shower Walls Kit (https://showerwallskit.com/).
